summary: Costamare Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release declaring quarterly cash dividends on its preferred stock (Series B, C, D) and common stock. The dividends are routine periodic payments with no price, premium, or special situation terms. The filing is a routine dividend declaration with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K is the equivalent of a U.S. 8-K for material non-special-situation news. The only action is the issuer declaring standard dividends.
